affected_boundaries: source discovery and snapshot collection to progress renderer

observed_behavior: Long source collection has no counted progress; later cached-file processing appears to jump straight to 100%. Initial placeholder bars never fill. Shortened TTY ETA leaves trailing characters.
expected_behavior: Every counted stage advances; unknown discovery stays live; terminal redraws erase previous text.
causal_mechanism: Callbacks cover only cached-file processing, after both source snapshots are collected. Placeholder lines are never updated. Carriage-return redraws omit padding.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Measure only a late pipeline stage and present static placeholders for earlier work.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Displayed completion does not account for the expensive stages; old terminal text remains visible.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Progress reports actual stage work and completion; unknown totals use liveness; redraws replace the whole prior line.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Instrument manifests, snapshots, cached files and publication; use spinner checkpoints/timer and printable redirected heartbeat; align labels and pad redraws. Count final publication only after commit.

applicability_conditions: Multi-stage indexing with expensive synchronous source collection and cached parses.
known_non_matches: Fast cached-file processing can legitimately complete between refreshes.
confirmation_evidence: Original callbacks are invoked only after snapshot collection.
Live TTY now shows zero and advancing source-file counts immediately.
regression_proofs: tests/project-index.test.js: source snapshots account for every file before database indexing
tests/project-index.test.js: publishes a complete generation with parameterized statements
